scope: READ ONLY provenance review; no production or frozen artifacts changed

verification_expectations.archive_verify: Independent of moved live models; objects, controls and manifests must remain byte-identical and pass --verify
verification_expectations.full_verify: Retains preexisting J1 in-place drift; zero models directly in in-place manifest
verification_expectations.live_sources_verify: Old model paths and old setup XML bytes no longer current; exact historical source-workspace verification is not a current-layout integrity guarantee
verification_expectations.structural_suite: collect_source_specs requires old models paths; after move old test may SKIP exact closure due to missing optional live workspace, not newly PASS. Preserve frozen test controls.

recommended_strategy: Store explicit prefix old→new layout mapping as versioned runtime compatibility, boundary-aware and Windows-separator-aware; avoid symlinks.
Capture every model file path/size/SHA before move and compare under mapped new paths; all numerical data, .osim and mesh bytes unchanged unless explicit path-only changes required.
Record each modified setup/XML JSON operational path file with before/after hashes and exact replacement reasons, never silently refresh SHA pins in a historical record.
Preserve archived reports/manifests/content-addressed objects and checkpoint weights/config bytes; map stale model paths at runtime after checkpoint config load.
Run default setup resolution for each family, native load/init model tests and operational smoke; label Mac-native vs Windows path-shape checks.

For strict historical replay use preserved Git revision or materialized archived namespace; any new migration-aware verifier is separate and must attest old and current digests, not assert old live source paths are retained.

known_specific_risks.reason: pins setup SHA5fa4748... and modelSHA33e67d... in metadata. Model data relocation fine; operational setupXML path rewrite changes setupSHA; preserve historical original pin and supply migration receipt rather than falsely refresh old attestation.

Has direct ROOT/model references and report-derived ROOT paths; operational validator needs resolution adapters if current use is intended; historical report and control fingerprint bytes must not be regenerated silently.

CONTROL_FILES direct repo paths and resolve_reference use raw Path join. Any compatibility wrapper must be explicit; old control fingerprint includes core source bytes so previously legitimate SEA migration/rootcode changes already invalidate strict old fingerprint.
